verdict.rationale: Munito AI's own docs show non-text capabilities on the same API platform: vision is listed among model capabilities, and audio is covered through a speech-to-text API and a transcription guide that also accepts short clips inside a chat request. The evidence never mentions image generation, and vision support is only a bullet in a capabilities list, so coverage of the story is incomplete. missing for 10: any image-generation model or endpoint, detailed vision documentation (supported models, input formats), audio beyond speech-to-text (e.g. text-to-speech), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can call vision, audio, or image-generation models beyond text chat on the same platform

citations.quote: Capabilities: structured outputs, tool calls, vision, speech to text, streaming, reasoning and prompt caching.
Munito AI supports the OpenAI Chat Completions, Responses and speech to text APIs, plus the Anthropic Messages API.
Transcribe audio. Turn recordings into text, or send short clips in a chat request.
